At some point, her boyfriend, 48-year-old Michael Morant, went there to look for her. After he found her, an argument ensued that led to her death, according to police.

Strausbaugh was the mother of two young boys.

Morant has been charged with first-degree murder and is being held without bail at the Baltimore County Detention Center.
